title: Microsemi Corporation Enters Definitive Agreement to Acquire PMC-Sierra, Inc.
主要内容: Microsemi Corporation (MSCC) and PMC-Sierra, Inc. have entered a definitive agreement for Microsemi to acquire PMC-Sierra for $9.22 in cash and 0.0771 of a share of Microsemi common stock per share of PMC common stock. The transaction is valued at approximately $2.5 billion, representing a 77.4% premium to PMC's stock closing price on Sept. 30, 2015. The deal is expected to be immediately accretive to Microsemi's non-GAAP EPS and free cash flow. The acquisition is anticipated to generate over $100 million in annual cost synergies, with more than $75 million realized in the first full quarter of combined operations. Funding will come from existing cash, $2.7 billion in new debt, and $0.6 billion in Microsemi common stock. Shareholders of both companies will own approximately 85% and 15% of the combined entity, respectively.
